subject: Workplace Skills
title: Saying No Strategically
description: A short lesson to help you apply Saying No Strategically.

hook.text: Warren Buffett credits most of his success not to what he said yes to but to the thousands of nos.

buildup.text: Every yes is a no to something else. Your calendar cannot expand, so every commitment has a hidden cost.

discovery.text: Strategic no means declining good opportunities to protect great ones. It requires clarity on priorities.

twist.text: People fear saying no because of social cost. But chronic yes-saying leads to burnout and broken promises.

climax.text: Use the formula: 'I appreciate this. My current priorities won't let me do it justice. Can I suggest someone?'

punchline.text: A kind no protects your best yes.

quiz.question: Why is saying no considered a productivity strategy?
options: It protects time for higher-priority commitments
It makes you seem more exclusive and valuable
